seoaeogeo.description: Remote MCP server that audits a public page for Google and AI search (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity): robots.txt rules per AI crawler, CDN and firewall blocks seen by OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, and text visible without JavaScript. Returns a ranked fix pack with where each fix lives in the codebase and how to verify it. Free preview, no account or API key.
